name: What is damaged board replacement?
description: Damaged board replacement involves removing and replacing sections of damaged wood to restore structural integrity and aesthetic appeal.

acceptedAnswer.text: Damaged board replacement involves removing and replacing sections of damaged wood, often due to rot, pests, or water damage, on various parts of a building's exterior or interior. This process restores structural integrity and aesthetic appeal. It's crucial to address damaged boards promptly to prevent further deterioration and more extensive repairs.
